messages:
sre-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: post-deploy spike after toggling ff/rate-limit-v2 in us-west-prod. Error-rate +1.2% above baseline, increased 502/5xx from inference-proxy. Pager P1. https://redwood/incident/5132109876
Priya: Ack. I'm taking this. grabbing runbook and context.
Miguel: I'm seeing rl_proxy logs show "token bucket refill negative" errors; looks like new threshold in v2 doesn't play well with refill timing.
Priya: Attempting kill-switch via feature-flag API now:
```
/ops/feature-flags toggle ff/rate-limit-v2 off --env prod --region us-west
```
Priya: toggle returned 500 from flag-service: {"error":"flag-service: stale cache"} — flag-service health degraded in us-west.
Miguel: Flag-service deployment 2.3.1 earlier might have introduced the cache race. Cache flush might recover faster than a full rollback.
Priya: Can we route traffic away from us-west while we fix?
Jordan: I can apply a traffic-steer to multi-region fallback but that will add latency for EU/APAC customers. Prefer kill-switch/cache flush first.
Nina: Any immediate customer SLA impact? Which accounts affected?
Miguel: Preliminary: ~0.8% of active streaming sessions got 502s and retried. Surface-level: degraded UX for a small subset of customers; no confirmed SLA breach yet but trend could reach thresholds if not resolved.
Priya: Plan: 1) try cache flush on flag-service 2) if fails, rollback flag-service to 2.2.9 3) as fallback, steer traffic out of us-west. Starting step 1.
Priya: Running:
```
curl -X POST "https://flags.internal/admin/flush?region=us-west" -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -v
```
Priya: flush -> 200 OK, now re-attempting toggle.
Priya: toggle succeeded :thumbsup: ff/rate-limit-v2 -> OFF in us-west.
sre-bot: Automation: scheduled health checks in 5m. Quick metric check: error-rate returned to baseline within ~2m of toggle.
Nina: Thanks — I'll notify CS to monitor top 10 affected accounts and prepare messaging if customers ask.
Jordan: On-call handoff at 03:00 UTC to me. Priya/Miguel, anything you want me to keep an eye on?
Priya: Logging all steps and commands to incident doc https://redwood/ops/incidents/5132109876. Marking mitigated for now. If it resurfaces, escalate to release-ops and revert the feature rollout gating.
Miguel: Follow-up: revert the 2.3.1 flag-service deploy, add cache-invalidation test to the release checklist, and run canary with longer warmup.
Jordan: Acknowledged. I'll monitor metrics and traces for 2 hours while oncall. :eyes:
sre-bot: Incident mitigated — auto-close check in 30m.
